scripts.infra:up: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres redis minio
scripts.infra:reset: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml down -v && docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres redis minio
scripts.dev:full: pnpm infra:up && pnpm db:migrate:deploy && pnpm dev
scripts.dev: concurrently "pnpm --filter @message2/api-gateway dev" "pnpm --filter @message2/messaging dev" "pnpm --filter @message2/media dev" "pnpm --filter @message2/notifications dev" "pnpm --filter @message2/access-audit dev" "pnpm --filter @message2/web dev"
